verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce itself (the core enrollment/token/mandate platform) is a closed, proprietary financial service with no source release, but the related Trusted Agent Protocol spec and reference implementation, plus the agent-toolkit, are published openly on GitHub with a runnable sample ecosystem (agent-registry, cdn-proxy, merchant-backend, tap-agent). This only covers peripheral protocol/toolkit components, not the core Intelligent Commerce platform's own source. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license grant for the core Intelligent Commerce platform itself, not just the TAP spec/toolkit sidecars.
